name: fee-optimizer-mcp
description: Compare crypto exchange fees across 18 venues with VIP tiers, funding rates, spread, slippage, fiat rails, and withdrawal costs. Recommends the cheapest venue.

tools.name: compare_exchange_fees
tools.description: Compare crypto exchange trading fees across venues with VIP tier resolution based on monthly volume, token discounts, and referral links.

tools.name: get_referral_link
tools.description: Get referral links for exchanges to reduce trading fees.

tools.name: calculate_savings
tools.description: Calculate savings by switching from one exchange to a cheaper alternative.

tools.name: compare_total_cost
tools.description: Compare total trading cost including fees, funding rates, spread, and slippage for a given order size.

tools.name: recommend_exchange
tools.description: Recommend the best exchange for specific trading needs based on country, volume, and pair.

tools.name: get_data_sources
tools.description: Get data source information, last-verified dates, and provenance for all bundled data.

tools.name: calculate_annual_cost
tools.description: Calculate annual trading cost projection based on monthly volume and trading patterns.

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Get perpetual futures funding rates — bundled long-run averages or live real-time rates via ccxt.

tools.name: get_execution_cost
tools.description: Calculate execution cost from bid-ask spread crossing and order-book depth-walk slippage.

tools.name: get_fiat_cost
tools.description: Get fiat on/off-ramp costs for card, SEPA, ACH, FPS, PIX, and SWIFT rails in USD/EUR/GBP/BRL.

tools.name: get_withdrawal_fees
tools.description: Get crypto withdrawal fees across Tron/Ethereum/BSC/L2/Solana/Ton/native chains for 16 assets.

tools.name: analyze_persona
tools.description: Analyze trading costs for a specific trader persona (spot trader, futures trader, DCA investor, etc.).

tools.name: analyze_token_discount
tools.description: Analyze native token holding discount impact on trading fees (BNB, OKB, GT, MX, BGB, KCS).

tools.name: compare_personas
tools.description: Compare trading costs across multiple trader personas side by side.

tools.name: volume_what_if
tools.description: Project fee tier changes and cost impact at different monthly trading volumes.

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Compare exchange availability and costs across countries with compliance filtering.

tools.name: get_account_fee_tier
tools.description: Fetch the account's actual maker/taker fee tier via authenticated exchange API. Credentials are never cached or logged.

tools.name: get_stablecoin_access
tools.description: Check MiCA stablecoin access rules by region — USDT unavailable at EEA venues after 2026-07-01 cliff; USDC/EURC/EURI authorized alternatives.

tools.name: compare_interface_costs
tools.description: Compare consumer app vs PRO interface costs with measured hidden-spread evidence (TUM 2025 real-money study data).
